Boris Kravchenko

**Education**

National Technical University, Kyiv | 2016

*Cloud Solutions Architect*

A seasoned platform engineer with a focus on scalable infrastructure and cost-efficient cloud solutions. Specializes in designing systems that balance performance, reliability, and operational simplicity. Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, with a strong emphasis on automation and team collaboration.
